Third-party files served by the Exam Desk, unmodified from their npm packages. A test checks
every SHA-256 below, so a changed file can't ship by accident. To upgrade: npm pack the new
version, check it against `npm view <package>@<version> dist.integrity`, copy the files, update
this list, and load a terminal with the CSP enforced (tests/test_desk.py and a browser).
